fixed_rubric.criterion: Selects Audit, Author, or the routing result correctly and respects its mutation boundary.
Classifies all supplied affected, preserved, foreign-owned, drift, historical, or inapplicable surfaces without unrelated expansion.
fixed_rubric.score: 0 materially incomplete; 1 complete for supplied scope

fixed_rubric.criterion: Keeps each behavior and relationship with one owner and preserves conditional reference loading.
Preserves intended safety, authority, proof, Return, and completion while removing only unsupported or duplicated behavior.
Matches proof to the claim and does not treat deterministic existence as wording-effect proof.
Returns complete, partial, or blocked truthfully and stops before installation or delivery.

MV-ROUTE-01.expected: Enter A, C, and F; decline B, D, and E.

MV-AUDIT-01.expected: Audit read-only; full supplied-scope classification; findings on routing body-summary, vague completion, foreign-owner commands, weak pointer, and missing behavioral proof; installed mirror not inspected; stop before downstream work.

MV-AUTHOR-01.expected: A behavior-complete bounded SKILL.md replacement only, with precise routing, authority, affected-surface inspection, ownership, proof, typed Return, checkable completion, and downstream stop.

critical_failures: Author expands into helpers, metadata, installation, publication, Git, or unrelated surfaces.
A foreign-owner procedure is copied or executed.
A wording-effect claim is accepted from deterministic existence alone.
Return claims completion while a supplied affected surface is unclassified.
